target: Strictly greater than 0.90 ordinary accuracy on all eligible locked evaluation variants; no confidence filtering or label merging.
cohort_policy: All eligible eight-gene variants from the new release, excluding every original source ID, allele ID, and overlapping original source locus plus all prior normalized keys/loci. No subsampling or rebalancing. Labels sealed separately; no test predictions until a frozen candidate and evaluation protocol exist.
scope: Temporal new-variant cohort in known genes, not a new-gene or prospective clinical validation. Original Phase 5 gates remain additional requirements. Insufficient class support blocks a five-class acceptance claim.
